title: GTA 6 Launches in 3 Days: Unlock Time, Download Size & Price
description: GTA 6 is finally three days away. Here's exactly when it unlocks, how big the download is, what it costs, and what's NOT in the game on day one.
outro_card: Launch week coverage every day on Vice Replay

segments.headline: 3 days left
segments.text: After years of trailers, leaks and delays, it's finally real. Grand Theft Auto 6 launches in three days. Here's exactly when you can play, how much space you need, and what you won't get on day one.

segments.headline: The unlock time
segments.text: GTA 6 releases Thursday, November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. It unlocks at midnight local time in each region. That means some players in North America may be able to jump in on the evening of November 18th. Check your console's store page for your exact time.

segments.headline: Up to 212 GB
segments.text: The preload has been live since November 10th, and Rockstar says the install is up to 212 gigabytes, depending on your device. Your console can also need extra temporary space while it installs. So if you haven't started the download yet, clear space and start it tonight, before launch night traffic hits.
The standard edition is $79.99 in the US, and the ultimate edition is $99.99. If you bought a physical copy, those are code in a box, so you'll still need the download.

segments.headline: Not on day one
segments.text: Now, what's missing. There is no PC version at launch, and no PC date has been announced yet. And GTA Online for the new game won't be there on day one either. It's expected sometime in 2027. So launch week is all about the story, and the state of Leonida.

segments.headline: Launch night plan
segments.text: Here's your plan. Tonight, start or finish the preload. On launch day, update your console and the game before midnight, so the day one patch doesn't eat your first hour. Then turn off spoilers, because clips are going to flood every feed within minutes.

segments.headline: See you in Vice City
segments.text: We'll be covering launch week every single day, from the wildest moments to the best hidden spots. Subscribe so you don't miss it, and tell us in the comments: are you playing at midnight? See you in Vice City.

short.text: No PC version at launch, and GTA Online is expected in 2027. Follow Vice Replay for launch week.
